payload.name: CellFusion C

It searches the Cafe24 product catalog, ranks suitable products, and displays recommendation cards with product images, prices, purchase links, and concise guidance.
payload.longDescription: CellFusion C 帮助用户根据肤质、肌肤问题、偏好的质地、使用场景和指定类别，查找合适的 CellFusionC 护肤产品。它会搜索 Cafe24 商品目录、为适合的产品排序，并显示包含商品图片、价格、购买链接和简明建议的推荐卡片。

payload.name: Bites
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.
payload.longDescription:
Bites 是一个 AI 原生点餐平台，让人们直接在 ChatGPT 中发现餐厅、浏览完整菜单，并向本地餐厅直接下单，无需切换到外卖应用。

顾客可以享受 AI 点餐的便利，同时看到店内菜单价格，没有加价或隐藏费用。他们可以按菜系或位置搜索、寻求推荐、定制餐点，并用自然语言组合多人订单。

示例：

“从 San Jose 的 Popeyes 点餐。”
“从 Mendocino Farms 点 2 份 Not So Fried Chicken 三明治，不要酱汁，使用无麸质面包。”
“从 Boltiful Santa Clara 为 10 人组合一份适合素食者的办公室午餐订单，每人低于 $20。添加几份甜点供团队分享。”
“给我看看 Curry Up Now 的菜单，帮我挑点辣的。”

对餐厅而言，Bites 支持 AI 驱动的直接点餐，不收佣金、不加价，餐厅完整掌握客户关系。餐厅可以减少对第三方外卖应用的依赖，同时保住利润，并通过顾客已经使用的渠道为他们服务。

简而言之，Bites 将外卖应用的便利与直接向餐厅点餐的经济优势相结合。

payload.name: LFmall
payload.description: 发现让你成为自己的品味，LFmall AI 购物
payload.summaryOriginal: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.
수만 개의 프리미엄 브랜드 상품 중 당신에게 딱 맞는 상품을 즉시 추천 받고, 공식몰만의 안전한 배송과 단독 혜택까지 한 번에 경험해 보세요. 
단순한 구매를 넘어 당신의 취향을 깊이 있게 완성해 드립니다.
payload.longDescription:
告别复杂搜索，用对话来购物。LFmall 能理解你的风格和场景（TPO），为你找到最符合“自我风格”的时尚与生活用品。
从数万件高端品牌商品中，即时为你推荐最合适的商品，还能一次享受官方商城的安心配送和独家优惠。
不止于购买，更深入地完善你的个人品味。

payload.name: Pararius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With Pararius, everyone can easily find the right home. Open the site or app and search the Netherlands' largest private-sector housing offering in just a few seconds. Type a city, neighbourhood or postcode to discover properties, use filters to refine listings by price, surface area, number of rooms or furnishing, set alerts to be the first to know about new homes and contact the agent directly. An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.
payload.longDescription: 借助 Pararius，每个人都能轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用，只需几秒即可搜索荷兰最大的私人住房市场。输入城市、街区或邮政编码发现房源，按价格、面积、房间数量或家具配置筛选，设置提醒以第一时间获知新房，并直接联系中介。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也能直观使用。从阿姆斯特丹的单间和公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅，找到适合你的家。

payload.name: CarsGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cars currently listed for sale across Australia and read expert reviews to help you decide. Browse thousands of new and used car listings by make, model, location, price range, and more — or just describe what you're looking for in plain language. Each result includes price, odometer, photos, and a direct link to the full listing. You can also find editorial reviews with expert ratings to compare models before you buy.
payload.longDescription: 搜索澳大利亚当前在售的汽车，并阅读专家评测，帮助你做出决定。按品牌、车型、地点、价格范围等条件浏览数千条新车和二手车信息，也可以直接用日常语言描述需求。每条结果都包含价格、里程表读数、照片以及完整车辆信息的直接链接。你还可以查看带专家评分的编辑评测，在购车前比较不同车型。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

Datos de fuentes oficiales. Si necesitas el informe COMPLETO (historial de ITV, kilometraje, titulares, cargas, valoración de mercado, robos y daños) la app te enlaza directamente al informe premium en analytics.transferautoonline.com.
payload.longDescription: 根据车牌免费查询任何在西班牙登记车辆的基本数据：品牌、车型、年份、燃料、车辆类型、排量和功率。数据来自官方来源。如果需要完整报告（ITV 年检历史、里程、车主、抵押或其他负担、市场估值、盗抢和损坏记录），应用会直接链接到 analytics.transferautoonline.com 上的付费高级报告。

payload.name: GrailPeople Shopping
payload.description: 查找真实可信的产品评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 7,000+ skincare, makeup, and hair products by ingredient, concern, or skin type, and get shopping recommendations. GrailPeople shows what beauty experts actually say, including estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty content creators. Every review comes with quotes, video timestamps, and creator credentials.
payload.longDescription: 按成分、关注问题或肤质搜索 7,000 多种护肤、彩妆和护发产品，并获取购物建议。GrailPeople 展示美容专家的真实观点，包括美容师、化妆师和美容内容创作者。每条评价都附有引述、视频时间戳和创作者资历。

payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Wild Calf Coffee
payload.description: 找到好咖啡并改善冲煮
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. You review price, shipping, tax, and payment in Shopify; the plugin does not place or charge an order in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 告诉 Wild Calf Coffee 你的冲煮方式和口味偏好。它会根据商品目录详情以及 Wild Calf 的品鉴和冲煮信息，为你匹配当前在售咖啡，解释每项推荐为何适合你，并指出尚未核实的批次特定信息。它可以先帮你排查咖啡寡淡、苦、酸或风味不稳定等问题，再推荐购买。准备好后，它会生成一次性 Shopify 购物车。你可在 Shopify 查看价格、运费、税费并付款；该插件不会在 ChatGPT 中下单或扣款。

payload.name: Pearl Auto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable
payload.longDescription:
人们经常会对车辆症状、维修需求或保养周期有疑问，但无法立即联系到合格的机械师或汽车专家。

Pearl Auto 聘请持证汽车技师和机械师审核 AI 答案。专家会明确标记每条 AI 答案为正确或不正确，让用户迅速判断信息是否可信。

来自多个领域的汽车专家会审核回答，包括一般汽车维修、柴油卡车、变速箱与传动系统、制动与悬架、电气系统、发动机诊断、暖通空调与温控，以及车身与喷漆。

此应用仅提供信息参考，不可替代专业汽车维修服务。

用户可以：
- 询问车辆症状、维修流程和保养方面的问题
- 查看认证技师是否将 AI 回答标记为正确或不正确
- 在无法联系到现场技师时及时获得安心参考

payload.name: Rakhys
payload.description: 查找最佳电子产品价格

Rakhys helps users compare electronics prices across major online stores in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

The app brings together product prices, specifications, and availability in one place, making it easier to find the best option before purchasing.

Rakhys provides:

Daily updated prices from multiple online retailers

Clear comparison of product specifications

AI-powered recommendations based on user needs

Rakhys is designed to save users time and money by helping them make informed buying decisions.

payload.name: broadbandnow.com
payload.description: 比较本地互联网服务提供商
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Search by ZIP code (like "91326") or city name (like "Los Angeles, California"). We'll show you every major internet provider serving your area - AT&T, Xfinity, Spectrum, Frontier, Starlink, and more.

- Provider brand information
- Star ratings based on real customer reviews
- Monthly pricing for different speed tiers
- Service types (Fiber, Cable, 5G, DSL)

payload.longDescription:
Broadbandnow.com 让你轻松找到合适的互联网服务提供商。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你的邮政编码或城市，即可通过精美的交互式展示立即查看可用 ISP 套餐、价格、速度和评分。

payload.name: NameEasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NameEasy helps parents and families find Indian baby names. Inside ChatGPT, search a catalogue of tens of thousands of names by religion (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Jain), gender, rashi, bhagwan, starting letter, or meaning. Designed for a new generation of parents.
payload.longDescription: NameEasy 帮助父母和家庭寻找印度婴儿名字。在 ChatGPT 中，你可以从数万个名字的目录中按宗教（印度教、穆斯林、锡克教、基督教、耆那教）、性别、rashi、bhagwan、首字母或含义搜索。为新一代父母而设计。

payload.name: Dominio Tech Delivery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find participating restaurants, browse menus and options, build a cart with current item prices and subtotal, and open the store's secure checkout with the items prefilled. For delivery, coverage, delivery fee, and total are calculated in checkout, where address, payment, and confirmation happen. Track a completed order using the code received after purchase.
payload.longDescription: 查找参与的餐厅、浏览菜单、按当前价格建立购物车并打开预填充的安全结账。配送范围、费用和总价在结账时计算，地址、付款和确认也在那里完成；可用购买后代码追踪订单。

payload.name: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Klinger-Vogt Immobilien is a modern real estate company focused on the regions of Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße. The app enables intuitive, location-based property searches for properties for sale, rent, and investment opportunities in the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan area.

Instead of browsing through endless property listings, users can discover available houses, apartments, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This allows them to assess location, surroundings, and infrastructure much faster and more realistically.

By combining regional market expertise with modern technology, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien creates a transparent and user-friendly way to find suitable properties in the region.

Advantages at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map interface
Faster orientation in Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
Focus on selected properties in the Rhine-Neckar region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
More efficient searching through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced local real estate experts
Modern and intuitive mobile experience

Whether it’s a modern city apartment in Mannheim, a family home in Ludwigshafen, or an investment property in Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien offers a contemporary and transparent gateway to the regional real estate market.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NiceBabyName helps parents find, analyze, and compare baby names using Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. Give it one name and it returns that name's Governing Planet, Temperament, Rising Sign, and Rising Degree, with meanings, a personality reading, and newborn-favorability notes. Launch an interactive wizard that walks you through three quick questions (terrain, riding style, typical distance) and returns a personalized recommendation from Cowboy's lineup: Cruiser, Cruiser ST, Cross, and Cross ST. Cowboy Model Finder 帮助骑行者找到最适合自己的 Cowboy 电动自行车，无需阅读规格表或手动比较参数表。

启动互动向导，回答三个简短问题（地形、骑行风格、通常骑行距离），即可从 Cowboy 产品系列中获得个性化推荐：Cruiser、Cruiser ST、Cross 和 Cross ST。你也可以要求并排比较两个指定车型，在对话中直接查看清晰的规格表。

payload.name: Texas Electricity
payload.description: 通过实际用电量对比电力计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Texas Electricity, from Meter Energy, compares residential electricity plans in deregulated Texas ZIP codes. Provide a ZIP code and optional monthly usage to see estimated bills, effective rates, contract terms, fees, renewable percentages, and available plan documents and signup links. Filter by exact or minimum contract length, retailer, or 100% renewable content. Usage defaults to 1,000 kWh per month, and searches without a retailer or term filter use 12-month plans. Compact comparisons show a curated selection sorted by estimated rate, may include Meter Energy's Standard plan, and favor selected providers; they are not an exhaustive list of the cheapest plans. If a requested retailer has no matches, results include other providers with an explanatory message. Estimates are not guaranteed bills. Signup takes place on an external website; the app does not enroll customers or access customer accounts. Search inputs and link clicks are recorded for analytics. Unsupported or unverified service areas return an error instead of fallback rates.
payload.longDescription: 由Meter Energy提供的Texas Electricity服务，可比较德克萨斯州非管制地区的邮编电力计划。输入邮编和可选的月用电量，即可查看预估账单、有效费率、合同条款、费用、可再生能源比例以及可用的计划文件和注册链接。按精确或最短合同期限、零售商或100%可再生能源内容进行筛选。默认用电量为每月1000千瓦时，未设置零售商或条款筛选的搜索将使用12个月计划。紧凑比较显示按预估费率排序的精选列表，可能包含Meter Energy的标准计划，并偏向选定的供应商；这些列表并非最便宜计划的完整列表。如果请求的零售商没有匹配结果，搜索结果将包含其他供应商并附有说明信息。预估结果不保证为实际账单。注册需在外部网站进行；该应用不会注册客户或访问客户账户。搜索输入和链接点击将被记录用于分析。不支持或未验证的服务区域将返回错误，而非备用费率。

Search the RE/MAX Türkiye property portfolio without leaving ChatGPT. From homes for sale or rent to commercial spaces and land, browse listings published on remax.com.tr simply by describing what you're looking for in your own words.

Mention @REMAX Turkiye and tell it what you need — a three-bedroom apartment in a gated complex in Ataşehir, or a detached house near the coast in İzmir. The app reads your location, budget, room count and other preferences, then returns the listings that match.

Each result shows the essentials at a glance: price, size, room count and location. When something catches your eye, open the full listing on remax.com.tr for photos, complete details and contact information for the RE/MAX Türkiye office handling the property.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 RE/MAX Türkiye 房产组合。从待售或出租住宅，到商业空间和土地，只需用自己的话描述需求，即可浏览 remax.com.tr 发布的房源。

提及 @REMAX Turkiye 并说明你的需求——例如位于 Ataşehir、带门禁社区内的三居室公寓，或 İzmir 海岸附近的独栋住宅。应用会读取你的位置、预算、房间数和其他偏好，然后返回匹配房源。

每个结果都会简要显示价格、面积、房间数和位置。看到感兴趣的房源后，可在 remax.com.tr 打开完整房源页面，查看照片、全部详情以及负责该房产的 RE/MAX Türkiye 办公室联系方式。

payload.name: doctorSIM Agentic Commerce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: doctorSIM Agentic Commerce helps users browse supported countries, identify mobile carriers, compare mobile top-up prices, buy gift cards, choose travel eSIM plans, preview order totals, place confirmed orders, and check order status through ChatGPT. payload.name: Monoblend AI Barista
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Monoblend AI Barista matches a user's described taste to the six-coffee Monoblend specialty lineup and then supports the practical steps that follow. From a description such as chocolatey and low-acid, bright and fruity, a gift, or decaf for the evening, it returns a Safe, a Curious and a Wild pick with a match score and the reason each one fits, and refines those picks from plain feedback like 'too sour' or 'I want it fuller'. Beyond matching, it generates brewing recipes tuned per method and per bean, pairs coffee with a described dish or a photo of a plate, diagnoses a cup that came out bitter, sour or watery, compares two beans side by side, builds a guided tasting flight for guests and gifts, and explains acidity, body, roast and processing in plain language. The app is informational only: it does not sell coffee, display prices, take orders or report stock, and it declines rather than inventing commercial or store details it does not hold.
payload.longDescription: Monoblend AI Barista 会将用户描述的口味与 Monoblend 六款精品咖啡系列匹配，并支持后续实用步骤。对于“巧克力风味、低酸”“明亮、果香”“送礼”或“晚间无咖啡因”等描述，它会给出稳妥、探索和大胆三种推荐，附匹配分数及理由，并根据“太酸了”或“想要更醇厚”等反馈调整推荐。除匹配外，它还会按冲煮方式和豆子生成配方，根据菜品描述或餐盘照片搭配咖啡，诊断苦、酸或寡淡的成品，横向比较两款豆子，为宾客和礼物设计引导式品鉴流程，并用通俗语言解释酸度、醇厚度、烘焙和处理方式。该应用仅提供信息：不销售咖啡、不显示价格、不接受订单或报告库存；对于没有掌握的商业或门店信息会拒绝回答，而不会凭空编造。

payload.name: Omny
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trouvez le bien qui correspond réellement à votre projet immobilier. Décrivez simplement votre recherche en langage naturel : budget, localisation, mode de vie, environnement ou critères spécifiques. Omny sélectionne les annonces les plus adaptées, vous permet de comparer vos favoris, de conserver vos préférences et de demander une visite en quelques étapes.
payload.longDescription: 找到真正符合你房产需求的房源。只需用自然语言描述搜索条件：预算、地点、生活方式、周边环境或具体标准。Omny 会筛选出最合适的房源，让你比较收藏项、保存偏好，并通过几个步骤申请看房。

payload.name: Pazarama
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Quickly find products on your shopping list on the Pazarama marketplace. Just say what you need—ChatGPT will compare models and provide direct purchase links for you. Experience Turkey's trusted marketplace at the speed of chat.
payload.longDescription: 快速在 Pazarama 市场查找购物清单中的商品。只需说出需求，ChatGPT 就会比较型号并提供直接购买链接。以聊天的速度体验土耳其值得信赖的市场。

payload.name: Cook and Scale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cook and Scale is where the recipes you actually cook go. Save them to your own book, and share the ones worth showing off — every recipe you publish gets its own page, with your photo, in up to six languages.

Share it wherever you already are. One tap and it is with your friends, your family, or the whole internet if you like. And anyone who opens it can cook from it straight away: change the number of servings and every amount rescales itself. No account, no app.

Getting a recipe in there is what this connector is for. Dictate your grandmother's lasagne, work out a weeknight dinner together, or hand over something you have been reading — the assistant does the typing, and it arrives as a real recipe, scalable, with a picture on it and ready for you to publish.

It can also keep your pantry and tell you what you could cook tonight, plan your week, and sort your book into collections.

Everything an assistant adds arrives privately in your Recipe inbox, where you review it. Publishing is always your own action on the website, never the assistant's. You choose which of seven permissions to grant when you connect, and you can change or revoke them at any time in your settings.
payload.longDescription:
Cook and Scale 是保存你实际烹饪食谱的地方。将食谱存入自己的食谱集，也可以分享值得展示的食谱——你发布的每份食谱都会拥有独立页面，配上你的照片，并支持多达六种语言。

可在你常用的地方分享。轻点一下，就能发送给朋友、家人，或者在你愿意时分享给全网。任何打开食谱的人都可以立即开始烹饪：更改份数后，所有用量都会自动按比例调整。无需账户，也无需安装应用。

这个连接器的用途就是帮你录入食谱。你可以口述祖母的千层面食谱、一起构思工作日晚餐，或交给助手一份你正在阅读的食谱——助手负责录入，最终会生成一份真正的食谱，可调整用量、配有图片并已准备好供你发布。

它还可以管理你的食品储藏室，告诉你今晚能做什么、规划一周菜单，并将食谱集整理为多个合集。

助手添加的所有内容都会私密地进入你的食谱收件箱，供你审核。发布始终由你本人在网站上操作，助手不会代为发布。连接时，你可以选择授予七项权限中的哪些权限，并随时在设置中更改或撤销。

payload.name: Astrotheoros
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the settings you already use in the app. It can also lookup Zodiacal Releasing or Vimshottari Dasha periods and organize your charts into folders.

Ask in plain language. "What are my transits this week?" "Compare my chart with Sam's." "Which zodiacal releasing period am I in right now?" "Add a note to Maria's chart about today's session." The assistant returns the same output as the app's copy button, so the numbers match what you see on screen, and you never have to type birth data into a chat.

The assistant works only with charts already in your account. It cannot create, edit, or delete charts, and it cannot change your settings. Requires an Astrotheoros account.
payload.longDescription:
Astrotheoros将你保存的星盘库连接到助手。登录后，助手可以查询账户中的任何星盘，根据这些星盘计算行运、推运、回归盘、比较盘和组合盘，并读写附加笔记，全部沿用你在应用中的设置。它还可以查询黄道释放法或Vimshottari Dasha周期，并将星盘整理到文件夹中。

用日常语言提问。“我这周的行运如何？”“比较我的星盘和Sam的星盘。”“我现在处于哪个黄道释放周期？”“在Maria的星盘中添加一条关于今天咨询的笔记。”助手返回与应用复制按钮相同的输出，因此数字与你在屏幕上看到的一致，而且你无需在聊天中输入出生数据。

助手只能处理你账户中已有的星盘。它不能创建、编辑或删除星盘，也不能更改设置。需要Astrotheoros账户。

payload.name: CogniFit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CogniFit is a clinically validated cognitive assessment and brain training platform trusted by millions of users worldwide.

Through the CogniFit MCP server, ChatGPT can help users discover cognitive assessments, explore brain training programs, receive personalized recommendations based on their goals or cognitive concerns, understand cognitive results, and access cognitive health insights.

CogniFit can also provide access to cognitive profiles, assessment results, personalized training plans, and additional cognitive health tools.
payload.longDescription:
CogniFit 是一个经过临床验证的认知评估和脑力训练平台，受到全球数百万用户的信赖。

通过 CogniFit MCP 服务器，ChatGPT 可以帮助用户发现认知评估、了解脑力训练计划、根据目标或认知方面的顾虑获得个性化建议、理解认知评估结果，并获取认知健康洞察。

CogniFit 还可提供认知档案、评估结果、个性化训练计划以及其他认知健康工具。

payload.name: Weather by WindBorne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

Ask your agent about the weather and get personalized insights powered by WeatherMesh, WindBorne's world-leading weather forecasting model, AI-based or otherwise.

Get a complete forecast at a glance, explore one variable in depth, or compare conditions across multiple locations. Find the best weather window for a run, flight, or the trip you have yet to plan - or watch storms, fronts, wind, and precipitation unfold on a map.
payload.longDescription:
WindBorne让您利用全球最大的气象气球星座数据，获得更精准的天气预报。每个气球可采集传统观测手段无法覆盖区域的关键实地数据，为美国国家气象局（NWS）、美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）及其他气象机构提供观测信息。

向您的代理询问天气情况，获取由WindBorne全球领先的天气预测模型WeatherMesh驱动的个性化洞察，该模型基于人工智能或其他技术实现。

一目了然获取完整预报，深入探索单一变量，或对比多个地点的天气状况。寻找跑步、飞行或未规划行程的最佳天气窗口——或在地图上实时观察风暴、锋面、风力和降水的变化。

payload.name: REMAX Europe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in any of 32 languages. Tapping a listing opens a full detail view with a photo carousel, description (with on-demand translation), agent contact, and a link to the full page on remax.eu.
payload.longDescription: REMAX Europe 让用户搜索欧洲 25 个国家/地区的实时 REMAX 房源，并在无需离开聊天的情况下通过图片丰富的交互式画廊浏览结果。用户可以用日常语言输入城市或国家/地区、预算、买卖或租赁、住宅或商业房产、最小面积或房间数、电梯需求，获取最多 100 个匹配房源，其中包含照片、价格和关键信息。结果可按价格或面积排序，并可使用 32 种语言查看。点击房源后会打开完整详情视图，其中包括照片轮播、描述（可按需翻译）、经纪人联系方式，以及 remax.eu 上完整页面的链接。

payload.name: Share-A-Cart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Share-A-Cart helps signed-in users list supported retailers, find products and deals, inspect carts in their cart history, and create or update shareable shopping carts from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Share-A-Cart 可帮助已登录用户列出受支持的零售商、查找商品和优惠、查看购物车历史中的购物车，并在 ChatGPT 中创建或更新可分享的购物车。

payload.name: Secondhand Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Depop, and Poshmark all without leaving ChatGPT. Search in plain language:  "a mid-century dresser under $250 near Denver" or "Lululemon Align leggings, size 6, under $60 near me"  and get real listings with prices, photos, seller details, and links. 

Filter by price, condition, brand, size, color and more. Have chat perform specific filters on analyzing photos for condition, or getting the right shade of brown that would take ages to do yourself on a manual marketplace search. Get local results, or items to ship. Every listing's full photo set is available so you can judge condition right in the conversation.  Free to start, no setup required.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 Facebook Marketplace、eBay、Depop 和 Poshmark。用自然语言搜索，例如：“丹佛附近 $250 以下的世纪中期梳妆柜”或“我附近 $60 以下、6 码的 Lululemon Align 紧身裤”，即可获取真实商品列表及价格、照片、卖家详情和链接。

按价格、成色、品牌、尺码、颜色等条件筛选。你可以让聊天根据照片分析成色，或找出合适的棕色色调；若手动在交易平台搜索，这些筛选可能要花很久。获取本地结果或可邮寄的商品。每个商品列表都提供完整照片集，方便你直接在对话中判断成色。免费开始使用，无需设置。

payload.name: Spotts - Korea Festival
payload.description: 查找韩国的公开活动和节日信息。
payload.summaryOriginal: 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 찾아봅니다.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spotts에서 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 검색하고 행사 일정·지역·종류·공개된 출연자 정보를 확인합니다. 읽기 전용으로 동작하며 사용자 계정 데이터나 예약·결제를 처리하지 않습니다.
payload.longDescription: 在Spotts中搜索韩国的公开活动和节日信息，可查看活动时间表、地区、类型及公开的演出者信息。该插件仅以只读方式运行，不处理用户账户数据或预订/支付操作。

payload.name: LiveSpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Ask in plain language - "what's on in Gothenburg this weekend", "concerts in Stockholm under 500 SEK" - and get current events with venue, date, price and a direct link to book. Search by free text, city, category, date range or budget; open full event details with description, venue, availability and ticket links; browse by city or category; and find similar events to one you like. Covers concerts, theatre, musicals, dance, comedy, sport, festivals and family events across Sweden, collected daily from 13 ticketing providers. Free and read-only: no account, no API key.
payload.longDescription: LiveSpot 是独立的瑞典活动指南。用自然语言提问——“本周末哥德堡有什么活动？”“斯德哥尔摩 500 SEK 以下的音乐会”——即可获得带场馆、日期、价格和直接购票链接的当前活动。可按自由文本、城市、类别、日期范围或预算搜索；打开包含描述、场馆、可用性和票务链接的完整活动详情；按城市或类别浏览；查找与你喜欢的活动相似的活动。覆盖瑞典各地的音乐会、戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈、喜剧、体育、节庆和家庭活动，每天从 13 家票务提供商收集信息。免费且只读：无需账户或 API 密钥。

payload.name: AjmerAstro
payload.description: 印度历法、出生星盘及KP星盘
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask in plain language — "today's panchang for Delhi", "my kundali for 18 June 1984, 3:55 PM, Ajmer, Rajasthan", "the KP chart for those details" — and get the computed values back.

Panchang and muhurat. Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vara for any date and
place, with the rahukaal, yamaganda and gulika windows, the abhijit muhurat and
the full choghadiya — the things people actually check before fixing a time to
begin something.

Janam kundali. Ascendant, planetary positions with nakshatra and pada, the D1
and D9 charts, the current mahadasha and antardasha, and whether Manglik dosha
is present.

KP charts. Cuspal positions with sign lord, star lord and sub lord, plus the
planetary significators.

Birth place lookup. Returns matching cities with their timezone, so an ambiguous
name can be confirmed before a chart is drawn. Timezones are worked out for the
exact date — a July birth in London uses BST, not GMT.

No account and no sign-up. Results are astronomical calculations and traditional
Vedic classifications — not predictions, and not medical, legal or financial
advice.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言提问——“德里今天的panchang”“我的出生星盘，1984年6月18日，下午3:55，拉贾斯坦邦阿杰梅尔”“这些信息对应的KP星盘”——即可获取计算结果。

Panchang历法与muhurat吉时。查询任意日期和
地点的tithi、nakshatra、yoga、karana和vara，以及rahukaal、yamaganda和gulika时段、abhijit muhurat
和完整choghadiya——这些都是人们在确定
开始某项事务的时间之前实际会查看的内容。

Janam kundali出生星盘。上升点、行星位置及其nakshatra和pada、D1
与D9星盘、当前的mahadasha和antardasha，以及是否存在Manglik dosha
。

KP星盘。宫头位置及其星座主星、星宿主星和次主星，以及
行星指示星。

出生地查询。返回匹配城市及其时区，以便在绘制星盘前确认
有歧义的地名。时区按确切日期计算
——7月在伦敦出生使用BST，而非GMT。

无需账户或注册。结果为天文计算和传统
吠陀分类——并非预测，也不是医疗、法律或财务
建议。

payload.name: idle.am
payload.description: 玩你的 idle MMO 角色。需要满足相关要求。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your idle.am character into your conversation. Check your character, skills, inventory, quests, and current task, then browse activities and manage supported gameplay with your assistant.

Interactive character, task, and activity cards show your portrait, progress, and available actions. Train skills, gather resources, start or stop tasks, travel, equip gear, prepare food, and handle quests. Actions follow the same level, location, equipment, and resource requirements as the game.

Connect your idle.am account through secure OAuth sign-in. No API key is required. You can disconnect at any time in idle.am Settings under Connected assistants. The connector cannot make purchases, trade, transfer bank items, send chat messages, or change account settings.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.
payload.longDescription:
探索 xmplaylist 跟踪的 SiriusXM 播放记录。查找歌曲在哪些地方播放、发现新加入电台的歌曲、查看电台播放次数最多的曲目，并比较歌曲和艺人获得的支持变化。查看已保存艺人名单的简报，再深入了解单个艺人的歌曲、电台和趋势。

结果会链接回 xmplaylist 报告，并说明所选时间段和可用覆盖范围。经你明确请求后，可准备 CSV 导出文件，并通过电子邮件发送下载链接。你也可以在聊天中查看最近一次导出的状态。

需要拥有 API 访问权限的 xmplaylist 账号。请求会占用你套餐的每日 API 配额。已记录的播放情况可能不完整；首次检测日期并不代表歌曲发行日期。xmplaylist 不是 SiriusXM 官方产品。

Every puzzle is shuffled with legal moves, so it can always be solved. New boards on demand, a timer and move counter, a short how-to-play primer for first-time players, and full localisation in English, Russian and Spanish. No account is needed and nothing is collected beyond anonymous usage analytics. The same game is free on the web at slide15.com and on iPhone and iPad.
payload.longDescription: Slide15 是一款无需离开 ChatGPT 即可游玩的滑块拼图。只需请求一个谜题，棋盘就会出现在对话中：滑动、轻点或使用方向键移动数字方块，直到数字按顺序排列。每个谜题都通过合法移动打乱，因此总能解出。可随时生成新棋盘，还提供计时器、步数计数器、供新手查看的简短玩法说明，以及完整的英语、俄语和西班牙语本地化。无需账户，除匿名使用分析外不会收集其他数据。同一款游戏也可在 slide15.com、iPhone 和 iPad 上免费游玩。

payload.name: Triad Astro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."
payload.longDescription:
Triad Astro 同时依据 3 种占星传统解读你的出生星盘——西方占星（回归黄道）、吠陀占星（恒星黄道）和中国命理（八字/四柱）——并展示它们的共通之处。

提供出生日期；如果知道，也提供出生时间和地点。它会一次性计算这 3 张星盘：西方体系的太阳、月亮和上升星座、行星相位及元素平衡；吠陀体系的纳克沙特拉、Navamsa、行星尊贵状态及 Vimshottari Dasha 时间线；以及中国体系的四柱、日主和十年大运。

大多数占星工具只给出一种体系的解读。Triad Astro 会提供 3 种解读，并帮助你查看其重叠之处——那些在 3 种体系中各自独立出现的主题，值得进一步关注。

行星位置依据符合 NASA JPL 标准的星历数据计算；出生地点会解析为坐标并自动处理时区，因此在已知出生时间时，星盘时间可精确到分钟。遇到含义不明确的地名时，可先查询并确认正确城市。

无需账户或登录。只需请求解读，例如：“计算我的三体系出生星盘。我出生于 1990 年 March 14 日上午 7:45，地点是 India 的 Bangalore。”

payload.name: TNT Sweeper

Reveal safe tiles on an 8-by-8 field, use numbers to identify adjacent explosives, and flag suspected TNT. Clear all 54 safe tiles while avoiding 10 explosives to win. The first reveal and its surrounding tiles are protected. Play with touch, mouse, or keyboard, and start another field using New game in the component. Unfinished runs expire after 60 minutes. No separate player account, payment, or advertising is required.

payload.name: Ziweave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Ziweave introduces Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology system, through readings based on your personal chart. Once you've finished setting up your birth details, Ziweave generates your chart and provides it to the AI, which uses the chart as the basis for its readings.

Ask about work, relationships or the themes of a month or year in your own words. Follow up with “Why?” or share what's happening in your life to explore how the reading relates to your situation. You bring the questions; the conversation helps make the chart easier to understand.

Try asking: “What does my chart suggest about my strengths at work, and how might I put them to use?”

payload.name: Storieta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask to see a classic and Storieta shows it: comic pages you can turn, scenes painted from the opening chapters, and portraits of the people in the story.

It covers public-domain novels and plays such as Frankenstein, Dracula, Pride and Prejudice, Wuthering Heights, and Romeo and Juliet. Each comic opens with its first pages here, and every result links to the book on storieta.com.

Storieta shows art it has already published. It doesn't draw on request, and it doesn't carry modern or copyrighted books.
payload.longDescription:
只需提出想阅读的经典作品，Storieta便会呈现：可翻页的漫画、根据开篇章节绘制的场景，以及故事中人物的肖像。

涵盖《弗兰肯斯坦》、《德古拉》、《傲慢与偏见》、《呼啸山庄》和《罗密欧与朱丽叶》等公共领域的小说和戏剧。每部漫画均从其前几页开始呈现，所有结果均链接至storieta.com上的原著书籍。

Storieta仅展示已出版的艺术作品，不接受定制创作，也不包含现代作品或受版权保护的书籍。

payload.name: 映画館ガイド | Eigakan Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find cinema showtimes across Japan without checking each cinema's website separately. Search by movie, area, cinema, date, start time, finish time, and screening features such as IMAX, Dolby Cinema, English audio, and English subtitles.

Eigakan Guide supports Japanese and English. Results include movie posters, cinemas, screening times in Japan Standard Time, and links to the matching listings on Eigakan Guide. Use Show more to load additional screenings with the same conditions.

An Eigakan Guide account is not required. The plugin searches collected schedules, not live seat availability, and cannot reserve seats or purchase tickets. Schedules can change; confirm the details on the cinema's official website before booking. Coverage is limited to supported cinemas and published schedules. English audio is marked only for eligible subtitled screenings of movies whose original English audio has been confirmed. English subtitles are a separate screening feature.
payload.longDescription:
无需逐一查看各家影院网站即可查询日本全国的电影院排片信息。可通过电影名称、地区、影院、日期、开始时间、结束时间以及IMAX、杜比影院、英语音轨、英语字幕等放映特色进行搜索。

Eigakan Guide支持日文和英文显示。搜索结果包含电影海报、影院信息、日本标准时间的放映时间，以及对应Eigakan Guide页面的链接。点击「显示更多」可加载相同条件下的更多排片信息。

无需Eigakan Guide账户即可使用。插件搜索的是已收录的排期信息，而非实时座位可售情况，无法预订座位或购买票务。排期信息可能随时变更，请在预订前务必通过影院官网确认详细信息。服务仅覆盖支持的影院及已发布的排期内容。英语音轨仅标注于确认原声为英语的字幕影片，英语字幕为独立放映特色。

payload.name: WhatsTheID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WhatsTheID connects your assistant to its database of DJ set tracklists from YouTube. Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Answers come from WhatsTheID's public tracklists, with links to the full tracklist and to the exact moment on YouTube.

Every track is labelled so you know how far to trust it: identified or still an unknown ID, and whether it comes from the uploader's own tracklist or YouTube's music detection, from listener comments, or from WhatsTheID's audio recognition. Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsTheID将您的助手连接至其收录的YouTube DJ混音曲目数据库。您可以询问某个混音集中播放了哪些曲目，视频特定时刻正在播放的曲目，某首曲目曾出现在哪些混音集中，或某频道最近上传了哪些内容。答案来自WhatsTheID的公开曲目列表，并附有完整曲目列表链接以及YouTube上的具体时间点链接。

每首曲目都会标注可信度信息：显示为已识别或未知ID，以及该曲目是来自上传者自有的曲目列表、YouTube音乐识别、听众评论，还是WhatsTheID的音频识别结果。预估时间会标注为预估时间。如果某个混音集尚未收录在WhatsTheID中，助手会明确说明并提供添加链接；绝不会猜测曲目列表。

工具：
- 搜索DJ混音集：通过DJ、活动、音乐节、俱乐部、频道或音乐类型查找混音集。
- 获取混音集曲目列表：通过YouTube链接获取某个混音集的完整曲目列表。
- 通过时间戳查找曲目：查找如42:10这样的特定时刻正在播放的曲目，包含前后曲目信息。
- 搜索曲目：查找某首曲目及其出现的混音集。
- 查看频道最新混音集：展示某频道最新上传的混音集及其曲目列表。

纯只读模式，无需账户即可使用。每个回答仅包含单个曲目列表或最多十个结果，并附有返回至whatstheid.com的链接。

information.value: Search DJ sets by DJ, event, channel or genre, Get the full tracklist of a YouTube DJ set, Find the track playing at any moment of a set, Find the sets a track was played in, List a channel's newest sets with tracklists
